name: Mobile Electronics Inc
old_description: Offering the distinct advantage of versatility and flexibility.
about:
Mobile Electronics Inc was founded in 1979 in Huntsville, Alabama. The company operates as a small business certified distributor of electronic connectors, specializing in circular connectors and backshell products for military and commercial applications.

The firm maintains an extensive in-stock inventory of connectors, cable clamps, tooling, and testing equipment at its Huntsville facility. Its sales team brings over 100 years of combined connector experience, providing application consultation, connector inspections, and counterfeit prevention services. The company emphasizes same-day shipping capabilities for in-stock items and includes certification with each shipment under its ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Mobile Electronics serves clients worldwide across aerospace, defense, and medical industries, with a strong presence in the avionics sector. Its customer base includes large manufacturing firms that rely on the distributor's ability to identify optimal interconnect solutions from project descriptions rather than part numbers alone.

The company attributes its competitive edge to the versatility and flexibility afforded by its small business structure, coupled with deep product knowledge. It highlights counterfeit prevention that exceeds industry standards and a commitment to rapid order fulfillment to prevent project delays.
